propositions: A declared-none file impact should keep its certified plan valid after an unrelated commit, without re-hashing dependencies or falling back to whole-HEAD freshness

The manifest signing flow must classify file scope into three states (paths, none, unscoped) based on dependency map and own scope, then emit an authenticated 'file-scope: none' declaration only when applicable
A none-scoped attestation must fail validity checks if the file-scope declaration is tampered with in unauthenticated plaintext or if scope/reason changes after signing

The material fingerprint for none-scoped records must include a canonical JSON basis member for the file-impact-scope declaration, making reason-only edits stale while preserving byte-compatibility for paths and unscoped records
Legacy empty-impact attestations without explicit scope declaration must continue to return stale-head after HEAD moves, preserving fail-closed behavior
